notes.title: Quizz is now free !!!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

I’ve decided to giveaway the single-player version of Quizz for free, so grab it now on!

notes.title: New Language Added - Romanian
notes.content:
- After some work and some debugging a new language has been added(Romanian).

- This step is a big one when it comes to expanding the game for other people and other regions.

- Hope for everything to work well and if you find any bug or problem, please write it on the game community or email me.
